description: Changing, withdrawing and ending a share.

preconditions: Share between owner An and viewer Binh; today is 2026-11-18; An and Binh are active and Binh is a Meeting Organizer.
Effective share Level1, 2026-11-18 to 2026-12-18, nothing pending.
cases.inputs: actor: Binh (viewer); values: level "Level2"; end null.
cases.return: Success ChangeRequested (MSG454); share stays Effective at Level1; PendingLevel Level2, PendingEndDate 2026-12-18, PendingRequestedAt now.
cases.log: Notification CalendarShareChangeRequested queued for An; audit calendar_share.change_requested with Current and Asked.

preconditions: Share between owner An and viewer Binh; today is 2026-11-18; An and Binh are active and Binh is a Meeting Organizer.
Effective share Level1, 2026-11-18 to 2026-12-18, nothing pending.
cases.inputs: actor: Binh; values: level "Level2"; end 2026-12-25; start 2026-11-18.
cases.return: Success ChangeRequested (MSG454); both level and end asked; the start equal to the current start is allowed.
cases.log: Notification queued for An; audit calendar_share.change_requested.
